class PlayerGameLaunchService[source]

Bases: object

Provide the data of the game launch screen.

Attributes:
METADATA_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Name of the metadata file of each game (metadata.json).

player_servicePlayerService

Player service.

professional_serviceProfessionalService

Professional service.

Methods

Return all players sorted by name.

get_all_professionals

get_all_players()[source]

Return all players sorted by name.

Returns:
list[Player]

Players sorted by name (case-sensitive).

get_all_professionals()[source]

Return all professionals sorted by name.

Returns:
list[Professional]

Professionals sorted by name (case-sensitive).

get_games_metadata()[source]

Read the metadata.json of each installed game.

Returns:
list[GameMetadata]

Metadata of the games, in folder name order.

Notes

Every subfolder of PathConfig.EXERGAME_DIR that has a metadata.json is read. Games with invalid metadata (ValueError) are skipped and the reason is logged as a warning; other errors (e.g. OSError) are not caught.
